text:
**Often, but not always.** Bundles can be cheaper than buying the same station and panel separately: for example, the [BLUETTI AC180 + 100W panel bundle](https://powersized.com/solar-generator-kits/) was listed at $649 versus $748 for the parts separately—a $99 saving.

But sales and panel choice can change the math. One comparison found an AC180 bundle at $729, while a discounted station plus a less expensive compatible third-party panel could total about $659 ([Dealectric’s comparison](https://dealectric.com/solar-generator-kit-vs-buying-separately)). Check the current prices for the exact components, and confirm a separate panel’s voltage and connector are compatible with the station.

judge.why: The lead example, a BLUETTI AC180 + 100W bundle at $649 vs $748, is cited to powersized.com and isn't our 200W kit. Dealectric appears only as a secondary comparison.
